Name: Simple Foliage - Ridgeside Village
Author: 1oOwOo1
Description:
将里奇赛德村的树木更改成Simple Foliage的风格，感谢itsanette和NinTheCactus的艺术创作！

[b][size=4]模组介绍[/size][/b]
  在游玩[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url][/b]的过程中，我无比怀念NinTheCactus的Ridgeside's Foliage - Fruit Trees。所以在得到许可后，我对模组进行了更新。
  除此以外，我还结合Simple Foliage，修改了开花山农场、夜莺果园的树木，让风格更加统一。

Change the trees in Ridgeside Village to the style of Simple Foliage, thanks to the artistic creations of itsanette and NinTheActus!

[b][size=4]Introduction [/size][/b]
  During my visit to Ridgeside Village, I missed NinTheActus' Ridgeside's Foliage - Fruit Trees immensely. So after obtaining permission, I updated the mod. 
  In addition, I also combined Simple Foliage to modify the trees in the Blooming Hill Farm and Nightingale Orchard, making the style more unified.
